# Mitutoyo America Corporation

> Mitutoyo delivers comprehensive precision metrology solutions for semiconductor, automotive, aerospace, and medical manufacturing industries.

Mitutoyo America Corporation is a global leader in precision measurement technology, offering over 5,500 metrology products including coordinate measuring machines (CMMs), vision systems, and integrated data management solutions. The company serves critical industries requiring high-precision inspection and measurement capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Precision Metrology
- Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM)
- Vision Measuring Systems
- MeasurLink Data Management
- Form Measurement
- Semiconductor Industry
- Electric Vehicle (EV) Industry
- Bearing Industry
- Aerospace Manufacturing
- Automotive Manufacturing
- Medical Device Manufacturing
- Linear Encoders
- DRO Systems
- ISO/IEC 17025 Compliance
- Manufacturing Automation

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Products and Solutions](https://mitutoyo.com/products-and-solutions): Comprehensive catalog of 5,500+ metrology products including CMMs, vision systems, and MeasurLink solutions for precision measurement across all industries.
- [Form Measurement Machines](https://mitutoyo.com/products/form-measurement-machine): Advanced form measurement machines with FORMTRACEPAK and ROUNDPAK software for analyzing complex geometries and surface characteristics.

## Equipment Selection & Guidance

- [Precision Machine Navigator](https://www.mitutoyo.com/pmn): Interactive equipment selector for precision measurement tools tailored to semiconductor, electric vehicle, and bearing industry requirements.

## Company Overview

- [Mitutoyo America Corporation Homepage](https://mitutoyo.com): Mitutoyo's main portal showcasing precision measurement solutions and expertise for aerospace, automotive, and medical manufacturing sectors.
